author: Colin and Samir
description:
This week we put eight creator businesses head to head in a bracket to figure out what it actually takes to build a great creator business.

01:29 - Feastables vs. Long Weekend

39:38 - Championship
42:39 - What We Learned
title: What Actually Makes a Good Creator Business
